race.comment: OUR EMILY (9) ran a better race last start to finish a close second over 1000m at Kempsey after missing the placings at the previous appearance. Taking on a better line-up this time but she has the ability to mix it with them with the 2kg claim. DIVINE SINNER (2) didn't make an impact at his last run before going for a spell on April 18, finishing ninth and beaten 7 lengths over 1400m at Dubbo. Has found a suitable race and is worth including while fresh. SORRENTO PALACE (6) is one from one over this track and trip and will be rock-hard fit for this contest. Top-three aspirations. NOR NOR WEST (3) next in line with the claim.
